## Change

What incident, evidence correction or helper change does this add?

## Evidence and uncertainty

Primary URLs, reported identifiers and gaps. For an existing incident, link its record.
No working exploit, copied article/post body, raw contract source or credentials.

## Checks

- [ ] Read CONTRIBUTING.md; checked for duplicate incidents/evidence.
- [ ] Metadata validator passes, if adding a submission.
- [ ] Offline synthetic checks pass, if changing helpers.
- [ ] New incident records remain proposed/unresolved and ineligible; frozen snapshots unchanged.
